rules: Face boxes are hard no-cover zones unless the overlay is deliberately behind a segmentation mask.
Above-head graphics must end at least 56px above the measured face top.
If the above-head zone is too small, switch to split_person_bottom_broll_top or full_cutaway_broll.
B-roll can replace the full frame or occupy a split-screen zone. It must not float over a face.
No automatic face detector is supplied. Measure actual frames; missing detection is unresolved, not a default-box pass.

subject_framing.purpose: Frame the raw human or product subject first, then place captions, b-roll, logos, and motion graphics around that locked subject map.
required_outputs: face/body or subject boxes as appropriate
rules: Run subject framing on raw or assembled source footage before hook text, captions, b-roll, logos, or motion graphics are placed.
If the subject is outside the target ranges, crop/reframe the source first. Do not compensate by moving overlays into unsafe areas.
For two-camera shoots, front and side angles must land on the same face/body anchor before side cutaways are approved.
A raw clip with the head too high, too low, off-centre, or cropped is not ready for the edit layer.

talking_head_full_1080x1920.use_when: Normal frontcam/talking-to-camera reel where the person owns the frame.

above_head_graphic_1080x1920.use_when: A graphic must sit above the head while the talking head stays visible.

split_person_bottom_broll_top_1080x1920.use_when: B-roll or proof footage owns the top panel and the person is framed lower.

full_cutaway_subject_or_product_1080x192.use_when: B-roll, UI, product, or generated footage replaces the talking head.

production_phases.name: Source intake
production_phases.rule: Inspect and classify the selected source. Use Drive listing only for Drive intake; do not move, rename, delete or change permissions during creative testing.

production_phases.name: Technical triage
production_phases.rule: Reject or proxy corrupt, audio-only, tiny, badly compressed, or wrong-orientation sources before creative planning.

production_phases.name: Content assessment
production_phases.rule: Decide what the footage can become from the content first, not from a template.

production_phases.name: Subject framing
production_phases.rule: Frame the person/product/UI before overlays. If the subject is wrong, fix the source frame before choosing caption or graphic positions.

production_phases.name: Route decision
production_phases.rule: Choose straight talking-head, above-head graphic, split-screen, full cutaway b-roll, motion-graphic, or carousel before building.

production_phases.name: Placement plan
production_phases.rule: Every logo, caption, b-roll panel, CTA, and motion graphic has a rect before render.

production_phases.name: Build and render
production_phases.rule: Use the selected renderer. Do not rebuild the pipeline in a one-off script.

production_phases.name: QC and export
production_phases.rule: A render is not finished until real frames pass subject, safe-zone, caption, audio, export, and upload-readiness checks.

use_when: The spoken idea is strong enough without proof footage.
The person is expressive and cleanly framed.
Motion graphics would distract more than they explain.
avoid_when: The source is mostly b-roll or screen recording

use_when: One concept needs a small visual explanation.
The face can sit lower without looking awkward.
The graphic can fit above the head with 56px clearance.
avoid_when: The graphic needs a large panel
The footage already has busy background motion

use_when: The line needs proof, UI, b-roll, or a visual metaphor while the speaker stays present.
The top safe panel can carry the proof without covering the face.
The speaker can be reframed lower and still look natural.
avoid_when: The speaker cannot be reframed lower

use_when: B-roll, screen recording, product, or generated footage should own the beat.
The cutaway adds information to the exact spoken line.
A split-screen would make the proof too small.
avoid_when: The subject/product is outside the safe rect

use_when: The asset is VO-led or fully synthetic.
There is no useful human footage.
The concept needs an animated explainer from start to finish.
avoid_when: The presenter's talking-head footage is the main asset
Real proof footage exists and is stronger

use_when: The source is a quote, framework, list, screenshot, testimonial, or still story.
The idea reads better as slides than motion.
The footage quality is weak but the content is useful.
avoid_when: The facial delivery is the hook
Motion or proof footage is essential
The asset needs a spoken cadence

talking_head_full.description: Normal talking-to-camera video with overlays only in safe zones.

allowed_zones.hook: safe_rect or reel_cover_9x16_grid_safe for cover frames
allowed_zones.captions: Inside the selected scenario safe rectangle and clear of measured faces; legacy lower-thirds require separately verified layout.

split_person_bottom_broll_top.description: Person remains bottom/lower canvas; b-roll or motion graphics live in the top safe panel.

above_head_graphic.description: Talking head stays full frame; graphic sits above the measured face.
rules: Graphic rect must fit inside the chosen profile safe_rect.
If face_top is above y=650, this style is not available.

full_cutaway_broll.description: B-roll replaces the frame for a short beat. Text/logos still respect platform safe zones.
rules: Use for proof footage, UI recordings, or metaphor shots that earn the line.
No persistent bottom-right watermark on vertical platforms.
Keep important subject/product inside safe_rect, not merely inside canvas.
Feed carousels may use a safe footer inside center80.
Story, TikTok, Reel cover, and Shorts thumbnails must not use bottom-right logos.
Photo overlays must use quiet-zone analysis and face avoidance before text placement.
